For investment-period networks, `sns` remains the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`; `create_model` converts only the value stored in model parameters via `_snapshots_parameter(sns, flat)`. It still passes the unchanged `sns` to variable and constraint builders, including loss builders, even when `"flat"` is selected. The context manager changes component-data representation, not those snapshot arguments.
